title: Storms to break heatwave, flooding up north could last for weeks
description: Flooding in North Queensland could last for several more weeks, and while the heatwave that has blanketed parts of the state comes to an end, it will be replaced by storms and severe winds.
content:
Queensland is set for another week of extreme weather as thunderstorms and severe winds break through the heatwave, while the flooding in north Queensland could last for weeks.
